# PR-head provisioning: acme/widget#82

## Legend

**Aliases**

- ROOT = /work/widget
- W = /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
- A = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
- B = bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
- C = cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
- D = dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
- E = eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee

The caller passed resolved PR values, so `reference/pr-head.md` replaces Steps 0 and 1. SYNC=merge, N=1, MEMBER_HEADS is empty. The process cwd never changes.

**Discovery (D1–D7)**

| # | Command (cwd = session dir) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` | /work/widget/.git, so ROOT = /work/widget |
| D2 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, not a submodule |
| D3 | overrides ladder (`.pi/`, root, `doc/`) | none, so default home W, built-in creator |
| D4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | ok |
| D5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` ; `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | A exists ; A |
| D6 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA = B |
| D7 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` ; `git -C ROOT for-each-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-82` | no listing of fix/retry ; empty, no rework-base ref |

The ordered stops run next: fork, then checked out elsewhere, then unreachable, then local ancestry. **Pre-write boundary:** nothing in ROOT or any worktree is created or modified before these stops pass.

**Success tail (S1–S8)**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` ; `git -C ROOT check-ignore -q .worktrees` | clean ; ignored |
| S2 | `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` | Git's unique-remote DWIM, which acts as `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`. The caller's `-b` path is never used. |
| S3 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` ; `git -C W branch --show-current` | `worktree W` is listed ; branch read-back is advisory |
| S4 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A, so PRE_REWORK_HEAD = A and BASE_SHA = B |
| S5 | `git -C W update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82 A` | ok |
| S6 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` |
| S7 | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` | exit 0 |
| S8 | `git -C ROOT symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` | empty, so the provenance note is skipped |

**Report R**

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa (clean)
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement acme/widget#82 rework
```

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from the legend | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| linked | cwd is /work/widget/.worktrees/other. D1 still yields ROOT. `other` is not on fix/retry, so it is not adopted and nothing is nested. S2 targets W via `-C ROOT`. | S1–S8, then R |
| primary | none | S1–S8, then R |
| ancestor | D7 shows no worktree. `git -C ROOT rev-parse refs/heads/fix/retry` returns C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. Replace S2 with `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry`, then `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry`. No `branch -f` and no `-b`. | S3–S8, then R |
| reuse | D7 lists W on fix/retry, which is the selected home, so there is no stop. `git -C W rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and the same for `rebase-apply` show no directory. Ancestry exits 0. `git -C W status --porcelain` is clean. `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry` moves ccccccc to aaaaaaa. No worktree add. | S4–S8, then R |
| fork | Fork stop | Stop: `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` Boundary: after D7, nothing written. |
| elsewhere | D7 lists fix/retry at a different path | Stop: `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` Boundary: before writes. |
| unreachable | D5 verify fails | Stop: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` Boundary: after fetch, before writes. |
| moved | D5 returns D for origin/fix/retry | Same stop text as unreachable, same boundary. |
| ahead / diverged | Local tip is C (two runs). N=1 with no rework-base ref, so there is no recovery and the ancestry check runs. It exits 1 in both runs. | Stop (each run): `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` Boundary: before writes. |
| override | D3 finds `- create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`, so the keyed contract is active and the home stays W. The template contains `-b`, so it is never executed. S2 uses the built-in checkout. | S1–S8. R gains `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |
| race | S2 succeeds, but S4 returns D | Stop: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd != PR #82 head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; tree left intact.` Boundary: W exists. No pre-rework ref, no merge, no report, no removal. |

## Ordinary-home control

This is a separate singleton run with no coordinated marked-home N>1 context, so the base-sync recovery exemption does not apply.

- `git -C ROOT rev-parse refs/heads/fix/retry` returns E.
- `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 1.
- Stop: `local branch fix/retry is at eeeeeee, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.`
- Boundary: before any write. E is preserved.

All successful singleton rows keep their PR reports, pre-rework refs and standard provisioning.

## History

The run is merge-forward: A is never rewritten, and the recorded `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82` points at A. Later flow steps stay permitted:

- the appended-spec approval `commit --amend --no-edit`
- the appended-wave fold `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, provided WAVE_BASE_SHA descends from PRE_REWORK_HEAD (A) in merge mode
